description:
Gamble! The Trivia Show About the Bets That Changed Everything.

Some people play it safe. Some people bet the whole thing on a single hand and either walk away legends or become a cautionary tale someone else tells at a dinner party.

Gamble is a live trivia game show about the moments people went all in. Sports, politics, business, history, entertainment, pop culture. The calculated risks, the desperate calls, the moves that had no business working and somehow did. And the ones that absolutely did not.

Frederick Smith turned in a paper about overnight delivery logistics in college. His professor gave him a C. He built FedEx anyway, then flew to Las Vegas with the company’s last $5,000 when it was about to go under. He won $27,000 at blackjack and made payroll.

Every era has a story like that. We’re going to make you remember all of them.

Nothing is too big, too small, or too audacious. If someone put something on the line, it’s fair game.

The Stakes (Format & Rounds)

 Opening Odds (Warm-up | ~20 mins)

Easy enough to get everyone confident. Dangerous enough that someone at your table is about to lose that confidence very quickly.

 All In (Main Rounds | ~60-75 mins)

Trivia, audio-visual rounds, and stories where you either knew how it ended or realise you had no idea. Sports gambles, political gambles, business gambles, personal gambles, history’s biggest swings, and the moments where one decision changed everything.

 Face Off

Two tables. One gamble. One team knows how it ended. The other is about to find out.

 The Bids

Bet your points. You know this one. You’re sure of it. Place your bets.

 Surprise Round (whenever)

A wildcard. Obviously. That’s all we’re saying.

How it works

Teams of up to 4. Come with a crew or we’ll find you one.

Flying solo? We’ll sort you out.

No finance degree or sports obsession required. Just curiosity and a tolerance for risk.

Prizes for the winners, a good time for everyone else.

Some bets pay off. Some do not. Come find out which ones.

Who is Tasty Trivia?

Saloni and Susovan are the co-curators of Tasty Trivia — Ashoka University alums who turned a shared love for curiosity into a live, fun, silly trivia game show series. They design every show, question, and experience themselves, and have taken it across 6 cities with a monthly run in Bangalore. They are eyeing to take the show to the Edinburgh Fringe Festival in 2027.

@gettastytrivia
 and join our

description:
Miss sitting on the last bench with your friends instead of being stuck in an office cubicle? Wish you were passing notes in class instead of replying to endless emails?

Unfortunately, we don’t have a time machine (yet), but we do have the next best thing! This Children’s Day, join us for a 90s quiz to take you back to your childhood.

Expect beginner-friendly and solvable questions on everything from iconic TV shows and unforgettable music to retro technology, fads, and trends. If you have never attended one of our quizzes before, this is a great place to start. Every question is framed in a way that will let you work out the answer, and we are liberal with hints.

About Calm Your Wits:

Calm Your Wits Quizzing is a Bengaluru-based quizzing collective that curates and hosts engaging, beginner-friendly pub quizzes across India. Founded by quizmaster Sanket Mandal, they have expanded beyond the Bengaluru quizzing circuit to host regular events in Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, Hyderabad, and even London. Launched with the intention of avoiding the intimidating archetype of traditional academic trivia, their style leans towards long-form questions, with lots of clues and audio-visual elements thrown in to help participants arrive at the answer.

Quizmaster Sanket also draws heavily from humour on social media, and uses tweets, Instagram reels, and memes to make questions on even the most serious of topics, as a way to remind people that all that doomscrolling can actually come in handy, and that knowledge can come from anywhere if we’re open to the possibilities.

Expect questions that keep you guessing, hints that reward lateral thinking, and a few intentional misdirects that may have you arguing with your teammates. Come early, and come curious!

You can follow them on Instagram 
@calm.your.wits.quizzing

description:
Have you ever had a question come up, linger in your mind only to disappear?  How does a plant know what leaf pattern to produce? Why do certain sounds sound more appealing than others?  How does one nation gain so much power? How does a smell suddenly transport us to a different place?

I see you nodding!   These bubbling questions are integral to humanity and probably the most wonderful thing about our existence.  But how often do we make time (and space) in our lives to pursue these side quests?   ‘A Brief Study Of’ at the Eleven AM Club is an attempt at that — making time to deeply learn, read, and write uninterrupted, along with others dedicated to the cause.

I imagine all of us bringing questions, books, and bookmarked articles each Sunday, and settling in for reading and writing in silence at the club.

If this is something you would like to do, come by. ABSO is an experiment, and hopefully, we have enough of us over time to continue meeting.

Schedule:

Three silent blocks of time at 3:20, 4:20 and 5:20pm.

Some topics we are reading currently:

Please note
 that you can read/ work through any topic of your choice. The idea is that we spend a slow and thoughtful afternoon browsing, discussing, note-taking, and collecting materials that spark curiosity.

About the Eleven AM Club

The Eleven AM Club is a space for slow, intentional gatherings where time stretches, stories unfold, and creativity finds room to breathe. Whether it’s writing, drawing, cooking, reading, playing, or simply being present, the club encourages meaningful moments without rush or agenda.

Creative Bloc Party (CBP) by The Habitat is a community-led performance platform that has hosted 150+ shows and featured 250+ artists across storytelling, poetry, music and spoken word.

After 4+ years of curating live shows and building a creative community, CBP is hosting its first-ever Open Mic Night in Bangalore.

This special edition creates a space where artists can experiment, audiences can discover new talent, and everyone shares a room full of live creative expression.

If you enjoy intimate performance spaces, honest storytelling, and discovering emerging artists, this evening is for you.

Event Highlights

 Live performances — storytelling & poetry

 Open mic slots available for performers

 A welcoming stage for first-time performers

 Meet Bangalore’s creative community

 Hosted by Creative Bloc Party (150+ shows in Mumbai)

Who should attend

Performers who want to try new material

Storytellers & poets

Anyone who enjoys live art and intimate performances

Want to perform?

Register for an open mic slot and take the stage.

Limited performer slots available.

About:

Harsh Shah is a storyteller, host and curator who has been performing real-life stories for over eight years at venues like The Habitat and other live performance spaces across the country. He is the founder of Creative Bloc Party (CBP), a community-driven platform for storytelling, poetry, music and spoken word. Through CBP, Harsh has curated 150+ shows featuring 200+ artists, creating intimate spaces where performers can experiment with their work and audiences can experience honest and powerful live performances. With the Open Mic Night, he aims to create a welcoming stage for both first-time performers and experienced artists to share their voices.

description:
Ukulele With Luv is bringing its community jam energy to Bangalore for the very first time! 

Uke Jam: Bangalore is an afternoon built for ukulele lovers of every level, inspired by the same spirit that powers Pune Uke Club back home. Here’s what to expect:

 Open Mic — Got a song you’ve been practicing? Take the stage and share it

 Guided Group Jam — Strum along to pre-decided songs together (beginner players welcome!)

 Special Performances — Hear from Bangalore’s own ukulele community and guest artists

 A room full of fellow players — Meet other uke enthusiasts from the city and beyond

 A relaxed, welcoming vibe — Come solo or bring a friend and soak in a Sunday afternoon of music

Whether you’ve just picked up a ukulele before or you’ve been playing for years, this is a space to learn, perform, and connect.

Spectators are welcome to join the Open Mic portion at a reduced entry price. Open to all ages 10 and above.

Who is Ukulele with Luv?

Organised by Ukulele With Luv, Pune’s most active ukulele teaching initiative. Founded and run by Luv Mahtani, a Pune-based musician, educator, community organiser, and experience curator. Luv is a James Hill Ukulele Initiative certified educator with over nine years of teaching experience. He is also the founder of Pune Uke Club, a grassroots ukulele community built on the belief that the ukulele is for everyone, known for its jams, open mics, and live events celebrating the joy of making music together. You set your space and begin your unfinished project: a piece of writing you’re finishing, crochet, a Lego set, postcards waiting to be written, or sketches that might turn into something new.

Or — you could dive into what we have here: Use the colourful papers, old magazines for collages, and books to inspire you. Use a medium you haven’t tried before.
